tools.name: validate_invoice_free
tools.description: Use before uploading an e-Factura to ANAF SPV, after generating invoice XML, or when ANAF rejected an invoice: validates a UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote (Romanian CIUS-RO 1.0.9, Peppol BIS 3.0, EN 16931) and returns every error with the fix in words, the UBL path of the field and, for amounts, the corr

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Use before uploading an e-Factura to ANAF SPV or sending a Peppol invoice, once the free quota of validate_invoice_free is used up (same report). Every rule violation with a plain-English fix, the UBL path of the field and, for amount errors, the correct value. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (ne

tools.name: fix_invoice
tools.description: Use when a validation report lists 'autofix' rules, or ANAF or a Peppol access point rejected an invoice for codes, dates or totals, and you want the corrected XML instead of editing it yourself: fixes county/sector/country/currency/unit codes, date formats, VAT-id prefixes, Belgian enterprise numbe

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Use when you have invoice data but no XML and need a Romanian e-Factura ANAF accepts: builds UBL 2.1 CIUS-RO XML from simple data (number, dates, seller and buyer CUI, lines with name, quantity, unit, price without VAT and VAT rate e.g. 21 or 11, optional IBAN). Company names, addresses, county code

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Use when building or checking an invoice for a Romanian company and you only have its CUI, or to check a partner before invoicing: ANAF data already in e-Factura form: legal name, VAT id (RO… only for VAT payers), trade register number, address with county as ISO code (RO-CJ) and Bucharest city as S

tools.name: company_financials
tools.description: Use when you need a Romanian company's size or financial health from its CUI (credit check before invoicing or selling on terms, lead qualification, due diligence): the annual statement filed with ANAF: CAEN code, turnover, revenue, expenses, net_result (profit positive, loss negative), employees, a

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Use when ANAF SPV, a Peppol access point or a validation report names a rule (e.g. BR-CO-15, BR-RO-110, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001) and you need to know what it means and how to fix it: official text in English and Romanian, plain-English fix and where the field lives in UBL. Free.

tools.name: validate_saft_free
tools.description: Use before filing a Romanian SAF-T (D406) with ANAF, or when ANAF's DUKIntegrator reported errors: same check as validate_saft, free: 1 file(s) per day per client IP, report limited to the first 10 findings (the total count is given).

tools.name: validate_saft
tools.description: Use before filing a Romanian SAF-T (D406) with ANAF, for the full report: runs ANAF's official validator (DUKIntegrator) for the reporting period and the consistency checks it does not do offline (balanced entries, GL totals, opening + movements = closing per account, trial balance, partner balances

tools.name: fx_rate
tools.description: Use for an invoice in a foreign currency (e-Factura needs the VAT in RON) or any RON conversion: official BNR (National Bank of Romania) rate, RON per 1 unit of the currency, for a date (default today; weekends/holidays return the last publication). Omit currency for all rates. Free.

tools.name: ro_holidays
tools.description: Use when planning payment or filing dates in Romania: public (legal) holidays for a year, incl. Orthodox Easter and Rusalii. Free.

tools.name: ro_business_day
tools.description: Use to compute a due date in Romanian working days (e.g. the 5 working days to upload an e-Factura): is a date a working day, which is the next one, and the date N working days later. Free.

tools.name: ro_tax_deadlines
tools.description: Use to know when Romanian returns are due: monthly filing deadlines (D112, D300, D100, D390, D394, D406) for a reporting month, moved to the next working day when they fall on a weekend or holiday. General rules; confirm special regimes with ANAF. Free.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Use before putting an IBAN on an invoice or paying to one: checks length and check digits and names the Romanian bank (or the State Treasury). Free.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fix_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when a validation report lists 'autofix' rules, or ANAF rejected an invoice for codes, dates or totals, and you want the corrected XML instead of editing it yourself: fixes county/sector/country/currency/unit codes, date formats, VAT-id prefixes, decimals, totals and VAT recomputed from the line" → after: "Use when a validation report lists 'autofix' rules, or ANAF or a Peppol access point rejected an invoice for codes, dates or totals, and you want the corrected XML instead of editing it yourself: fixes county/sector/country/currency/unit codes, date formats, VAT-id prefixes, Belgian enterprise numbe"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
